pending_interview.question: You are given the root of a binary tree in which each node contains an integer value. Write a function that returns the number of paths in the tree where the values along the path sum to a given target. A path does not need to start at the root or end at a leaf, but it must go downward (from parent to child). What is the time complexity of your approach, and can you do better than the naive O(n^2) solution? Explain your reasoning before writing any code.
